paragraphs.text: The whole world fits inside a seed — the heart-seed — and here are the proofs. Similes first: as the banyan seed somehow holds the whole tree, as peacock-egg juice somehow holds every feather. Then the clay proof: pots and bowls, examined, turn out to be just clay. Then the water proof: watery kinds settle into water-in-common. Then the word proof: strip the word being down to its bare letter s, and inside it stand thirty-one levels; past it, pure knowing, the Lord, and eternal Shiva enter the syllable au, shaped as assent, formed of unsurpassed power. So supreme emission happens, creation above and below. And whoever truly knows such a heart-seed and enters it is initiated in the highest sense — no sesame, no ghee, no fire needed. Still breathing, living like everyone else, free while living; and when the body falls, the Lord Himself.
